sn44.10:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn44.10:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn44.10:1.3: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama atthattāti.
sn44.10:1.7: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
sn44.10:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando acirapakkante vacchagotte paribbājake bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn44.10:2.2: kiṃ nu kho bhante bhagavā vacchagotassa paribbājakassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākāsīti.
sn44.10:2.3: ahañcānanda vacchagottassa paribbājakassa atthattāti puṭṭho samāno atthattāti byākareyyaṃ. ye te ānanda samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā tesametaṃ saddhiṃ abhavissa.
sn44.10:2.4: ahañcānanda vacchagottassa paribbājakassa natthattāti puṭṭho samāno natthattāti byākareyyaṃ. ye te ānanda samaṇabrāhmaṇā ucchedavādā tesametaṃ saddhiṃ abhavissa.
sn44.10:2.5: ahañcānanda vacchagottassa paribbājakassa atthattāti puṭṭho samāno atthattāti byākareyyaṃ. api nu metaṃ ānanda anulomaṃ abhavissa ñāṇassa uppādāya
sn44.10:2.8: ahañcānanda vacchagottassa paribbājakassa natthattāti puṭṭho samāno natthattāti bayākareyyaṃ. sammūḷhassa ānanda vacchagottassa paribbājakassa bhiyyosammohāya abhavissa
sn44.10:2.9: ahu vā me nūna pubbe attā so etarahi natthīti.
